description: This file defines the TransactionFactory interface within the org.apache.ofbiz.entity.transaction package, specifying methods for obtaining transaction managers, user transactions, database connections, and lifecycle management related to transactions.

classes.name: TransactionFactory
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for transaction factory implementations, providing methods to manage transaction objects and connections.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns the transaction manager responsible for managing transactions.

methods.name: getUserTransaction
methods.description: Returns the user transaction object for managing user-level transactions.

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the transaction manager.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides a database connection based on the provided helper info, potentially throwing SQL or entity-related exceptions.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Performs shutdown operations for the transaction factory, releasing resources as needed.
